title: Nosferatu Great Forest
paragraphs: “I wonder what would have happened if we had tried this on that princess?” Father murmured.
Well, as Father said, we managed to defeat the otome game soul transferor, advanced the doctor’s research, and improved the enemy detection rate.
“Hmmm…”
I feel like I’m forgetting something. Yesterday, we defeated the pig that had possessed another pig.
“By the way, the wave schedule looks open.”

It’s morning at the castle now. After breakfast, Father and the others were checking the schedule of the waves occurring around the world. Yuki-chan and the others had gone out for their morning walk. Rivals were doing something similar. If there’s nothing pressing, I’ll be studying with Father and the others in the castle.
“Rather than saying it’s open, shouldn’t we say it’s been kept open? It’s because of the jurisdiction of the Queen, the Staff Hero of Melromarc.”
“Ah, I see. Is there anything we can do during that time?”
“Father, isn’t it about time we started mass breeding the Filolials?”
“Again with that…”
“Well, well, I was thinking it’s about time we increased our manpower properly, so it’s not a bad idea.”
Oh! Father has given his approval. This must be done.
“Indeed… if we don’t have a few more allies, who knows what the Pig King might do…”
“Exactly. It’s best to increase our numbers.”
“However, we should avoid the kind of incidents that happen with Motoyasu’s companions running wild.”
It seems that neither Ren nor Itsuki are opposed to the idea. Now, I can finally go all out in searching for Filo-tan.
“This time, I will definitely find Filo-tan. I have more than enough funds now, so it should be possible.”
When I went to Siltvelt, I bought everything with the reward money for escorting Father. When we stayed in Melromarc, I reclaimed it from the Three Heroes Church. Next is Faubrey.
“This time, I’ll buy everything up using Faubrey’s wealth!”
“Did you just say buy everything up!?”
“Well… we do have enough wealth for that, and we’re carrying plenty of money…”
“Raising them is going to be a hassle.”
“No need to worry! Last time—”
And that’s when I remembered. The blue sea, the white clouds, and the activation event!
“It’s about time for the activation phenomenon on Cal Mira Island!”
“Activation?”
“If we’re talking in game terms, it’s like an experience boost event, right?”
“Exactly! There’s also magic on Cal Mira Island that only heroes can use, so I think it’s worth going!”
“Hmm, so there’s an event like that happening?”
“That being said…”
Ren and Itsuki’s enthusiasm seems a bit different than usual. Normally, during events, both Ren and Itsuki would get fired up, but now they’re quite calm.
“There’s usually a level cap. Considering our current levels, I think we’ve already hit the limit.”
“Yeah. Motoyasu, what’s the level cap for the Cal Mira Island event?”
Hmm… these two level-up maniacs reacting like this? What boring people. Get more excited, will you!?
“It’s smooth sailing up to level 80.”
“See? That’s not very impressive for us at this point.”
“True. It’s not that we won’t participate, but it’s not something to get excited about.”
“For max-level users, it’s not that rewarding. It’s more like an experience boost event for those still catching up…”
Even Father is losing a bit of his enthusiasm because of them. At this rate, the Filolial-sama project is…!
“What are you all sighing about? This is the glorious event where Father left us all in the dust in terms of strength!”
During the hero exchange that took place back then, Father realized the secret to our strength and made tremendous progress. At the same time, we were all left to fall into ruin.
“If we hadn’t gone to Cal Mira Island, neither Father nor we would have become stronger. It’s no exaggeration to say that!”
“I get that… but, well, leveling is used for enhancing our skills and attributes, so if it’s a beneficial event, participating wouldn’t be a bad idea.”
“True, but…”
“We’ve been constantly fighting, after all. I can’t deny that I’d like a little break.”
Hmm… no one seems very eager about this. And that’s when Éclair entered the room.
“Excuse me. Hm? What’s going on here?”
“Ah, Éclair. Did something happen with you?”
“No, there’s no particular issue, but I hadn’t heard about the heroes’ upcoming plans.”
“We’re discussing whether to go to Faubrey and listen to the king’s request, or whether to head to a place called Cal Mira Island like Motoyasu mentioned.”
“I see… activation, huh? If that’s the case, I’ve heard there’s going to be a similar phenomenon near Faubrey in about a month.”
“This is news to me.”
So, activation happens outside of Cal Mira Island as well. Well, if I think about it, it’s a natural phenomenon, so that’s only logical.
“It’s said that a similar event will take place in a forest called the Nosferatu Great Forest. It’s beyond a rather rugged mountain range, though.”
“Hmm…”
“Since it’s already too late to make it to Cal Mira Island, most of the adventurers around here have started moving toward the Nosferatu Great Forest.”
“We can portal to somewhere near Melromarc, so it’s more a matter of whether we need to hurry… I see.”
“Either way, it’s for leveling up. For us right now, it’s more about boosting our overall strength.”

“It’s good for strengthening our forces, right? I’d like to have enough power to face the waves without relying on the heroes. In that sense, being able to use both Cal Mira Island and the Nosferatu Great Forest is a big advantage.”
Exactly, exactly. I’m on Father’s side.
“I’ll definitely find Filo-tan this time!”
“Since Motoyasu is saying that, maybe it’s about time we seriously help him out.”
“We’ve been dragged into plenty of trouble because of it, though…”
“That’s true, but without Motoyasu, we would’ve just been clowns playing along with a farce. We should at least help him a little. It’s about raising Filolials, right?”
“No, that’s not it. First, it’s about finding Filo-tan. Of course, even if the Filolials we purchase aren’t Filo-tan, I would never abandon them.”
“So, either way, we’ll be raising them, but the goal is to reunite with the Filo that I raised in the first world, right?”
Oh! Father has grasped exactly what I wanted to say.
I… am so overwhelmed with emotion that I can’t stop the tears.
“Looks like that’s pretty much it. But are we really about to embark on a journey to find a needle in a desert?”
“It’s definitely like chasing clouds. Motoyasu, do you have any leads?”
“Well… if we just randomly buy Filolial eggs without a purpose, the chances of finding her are pretty low.”
Father said something similar last time as well. So, I told Father and the others everything that’s happened so far to get their input.
“Filo was recruited by Naofumi after the first wave in the first world… right?”
“There’s no way for us to confirm where he bought her now.”
“Motoyasu assumed that the monster merchant he favored around that time was suspicious and tried buying up everything in Siltvelt during that loop…”
Exactly. First, we need to figure out where Father got Filo-tan. I haven’t encountered Filo-tan even once in all my loops so far. That part bothers me.
“So, what kind of creature is this Filo anyway?”
Ren is asking that now of all times? How can he not know? After all the times I’ve explained it, how can he not remember!?
